calculation.description: Measures recent 20-day performance relative to the equal-time-scale component of the 60-day trend, normalized by trailing 40-day daily volatility. The negative predictive IC indicates that stronger recent acceleration relative to the longer trend has historically tended to mean-revert over the tested horizons. Use the factor with a negative direction when converting scores to forecasts. All inputs are lagged through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Negative IC was observed in every tested year except 2027, with especially strong negative relationships in 2026, 2028, 2029, 2030, and 2031 YTD. The factor passes the absolute daily paper IC and ICIR gates, but estimates remain uncertain because the cross-section has only 15 instruments. The 20-day effect strengthened relative to 5- and 10-day horizons, suggesting medium-horizon mean reversion.

signal_provenance.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation of factor values with forward close-to-close returns; rows require at least 8 valid instruments.
